event_data.context:
Projects with an existing tracked policy and plugin-owned workflow guidance can preview an update, but applying that approved update currently rejects the existing configuration and treats expected plugin-owned drift as a conflict. The setup workflow should report a true no-op when nothing changes or reconcile generated policy safely while preserving explicitly enabled optional capabilities. This restores a supported upgrade path and avoids risky manual configuration edits.

Implementation notes

Reproduce from the schema-version-2 configuration and initialized legacy task workspace described in GitHub issue #76. Ensure dry-run and apply agree, reconcile plugin-owned formula changes, and preserve user-owned customizations and optional feature flags.

Source: https://github.com/jwilger/ai-plugins/issues/76
event_data.summary: Allow projects configured by an earlier Development System version to converge safely on the current generated policy instead of failing or requiring manual edits.
event_data.title: Let existing projects safely adopt updated Development System policy
